verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks that a programmatic consumer can receive. Users set up webhooks of a given event type (e.g. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED) with structured payloads (customer-screening.step_output.screening_result). Each delivery carries a webhook-id header to use as an idempotency key, and account-level signing is available as an opt-in. Missing for 10: a full catalogue of subscribable event types, documentation of how subscriptions are registered (API vs UI), retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
